verdict.rationale: Synctera documents creating and managing customer accounts across multiple types, including SAVING and CHECKING demand deposit accounts. That implies per-customer bank accounts, but the evidence never mentions issuing account or routing numbers, virtual accounts, or hierarchical sub-account structures. Missing for 10: explicit account/routing number issuance, virtual accounts for reconciliation, master/sub-account hierarchy, evidence of provisioning at scale, independent corroboration.
